in_marathi.name: अमोल
in_marathi.long_meaning: अमोल हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name अमोल is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अमौल’, which means ‘immortal’. In Hindu mythology, Amol is a divine name associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing eternal happiness and prosperity.
